description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'TerminationReasonConfigurationServiceTest' for the 'TerminationReasonConfigurationService' in the OrangeHRM system. It tests various methods such as retrieving, deleting, and querying termination reasons, and uses mock objects to verify interactions with the data access object.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing 'TerminationReasonConfigurationService' methods related to termination reasons handling, including list retrieval, fetch by id, delete, and fetch by name. Uses mock DAO and test data fixtures.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case with a new service instance and loads test fixtures before each test

methods.name: testGetTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the termination reason list from service using a mock DAO

methods.name: testGetTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Tests fetching a termination reason by its ID

methods.name: testDeleteTerminationReasons
methods.description: Tests deletion of termination reasons via service

methods.name: testGetTerminationReasonByName
methods.description: Tests fetching a termination reason by its name
